Privacy Policy

Last updated: 21 October 2026

We respect your privacy. This page explains our approach to data when you use the Monumen Selamat Datang Guide.

Information and actual features

There are no accounts, bookings, contact forms or email submission channels. Technical hosting providers may process basic request data such as IP address, browser and requested pages under their own policies. Hosting may also independently inject Cloudflare Web Analytics to measure page performance and load timing. This is separate from Google Analytics and its consent choice.

Local choices

The page URL determines language. Consent is saved in local storage; the field list is stored across visits only if optional preferences are enabled. Storage may be blocked; a failed save is reported.

Third-party services

The Google Maps embed and Google Fonts load as external resources. Google Analytics loads only after explicit analytics consent. These providers have their own privacy policies.

Your controls

Use Cookie Settings to change or withdraw Google Analytics consent. Rejecting Google Analytics does not disable all hosting analytics, including hosting-injected Cloudflare Web Analytics. Withdrawal immediately disables Google Analytics without reloading. If storage fails, the settings message explains whether denial lasts only on the loaded page or also across reloads in this tab; other tabs and browsers may use the old choice. Browser settings can clear existing local storage and third-party cookies.
